Gold Rate Today

Gold Rate Today in Delhi — and How Your Payout Is Calculated

Gold rates change every day, so we do not print a stale number on this page. Call us on +91 9990780499 for today's live gold buying rate — then use the formula below to verify any buyer's calculation, including ours.

The Formula

Payout = net weight of pure gold × today's rate per gram of pure gold. Your item's weight is converted to pure-gold weight using its tested purity, and that pure weight is multiplied by the day's rate.

Purity Table (BIS)

KaratPurityCommon use
24K99.9%Coins and bars
22K91.6%Classic Indian jewellery (hallmark 916)
18K75.0%Diamond jewellery (hallmark 750)
14K58.5%Light everyday jewellery

A Worked Example (Illustrative Numbers Only)

Suppose — purely as an illustration, not a quote — the day's pure-gold rate is ₹7,500 per gram, and you bring a 22K bangle weighing 12 grams. Pure-gold weight = 12 × 0.916 = 10.992 g. Payout = 10.992 × ₹7,500 = ₹82,440. The actual rate on the day you visit will be different — call us for today's figure, and watch the same calculation done in front of you at the counter after a free German Karat Meter test.

Why We Don't Publish a Fixed Rate Here

The rate follows the international gold price and the rupee–dollar exchange rate, and moves daily — sometimes within the day. Any rate printed on a website would mislead someone within hours. An honest buyer states the day's rate at the counter, shows you the purity and weight, and lets you verify the multiplication yourself.
